programme.desc: Luma Simms grew up in a Christian family in Iraq. For her as a child, Christianity was very much a cultural identity, tied also to her experience of the Orthodox Faith. When her family left Iraq before coming to the US, they encountered Evangelical missionaries who told them they were not "real” Christians yet, and that they had to adopt Evangelicalism. Along the way, Luma began to gravitate toward a more Calvinist expression of Christianity. But when that theology began to unravel, she started to look deeper into historical theology, finding that her true Christian home was in the Catholic Church, which she entered in 2018.

programme.desc: Luma Simms grew up in a Christian family in Iraq. For her as a child, Christianity was very much a cultural identity, tied also to her experience of the Orthodox Faith. When her family left Iraq before coming to the US, they encountered Evangelical missionaries who told them they were not "real” Christians yet, and that they had to adopt Evangelicalism. Along the way, Luma began to gravitate toward a more Calvinist expression of Christianity. But when that theology began to unravel, she started to look deeper into historical theology, finding that her true Christian home was in the Catholic Church, which she entered in 2018.

programme.title: Sri Lanka : Jésus, Sauve Le Sri Lanka !
programme.desc: Le 21 avril 2019 – le dimanche de Pâques – vers 08h45, une série d'attentats à la bombe a frappé Colombo, la capitale du Sri Lanka, en commençant avec une explosion à l'église catholique de Saint-Antoine, qui a le statut de sanctuaire national. Moins de 45 minutes plus tard, une autre bombe a explosé à l'église catholique Saint-Sébastien de Negomba, tandis qu’une troisième explosion s’est produite à l'église protestante de Sion à Batticaloa. Au même moment, des explosions se sont produites dans trois hôtels de Colombo prisés par les touristes occidentaux. Le bilan définitif est de 264 morts et plus de 500 blessés. L'État islamique a revendiqué les attentats, mais le gouvernement a accusé un groupe extrémiste islamiste local, le National Thawheed Jamaath (NTJ), d'être responsable des attentats. Après près d'un an, 300 personnes ont été arrêtées et certaines des églises ont été réparées, reconsacrées et rouvertes. Aujourd'hui, plus d'un an plus tard, les Srilankais ont toujours peur tout en continuant à soigner leurs blessures physiques et psychologiques.

programme.title: Vaticano
programme.desc: Esta semana en Vaticano, exploramos el camino cristiano hacia la eternidad. Desde las antiguas catacumbas de Roma, donde los primeros cristianos sepultaban a sus difuntos y proclamaban su esperanza en la vida después de la muerte, hasta el Dicasterio de las Causas de los Santos, donde la Iglesia sigue presentando a hombres y mujeres de virtudes heroicas como modelos de santidad, descubrimos qué significa vivir con el cielo como destino último. También conversamos con un capellán de hospital sobre el sacramento de la Unción de los Enfermos y visitamos el Museo de las Almas del Purgatorio para profundizar en la enseñanza de la Iglesia sobre el purgatorio y en la esperanza que une a vivos y difuntos.

programme.title: Tertulias de fe
programme.desc: El Padre Gerardo Mendoza es un sacerdote de la Diócesis de San Bernardino que fue ordenado en julio de 1988 y cuenta con casi cuatro décadas de trayectoria pastoral en el sur de California. A lo largo de su ministerio, ha servido como párroco en iglesias de ciudades como Norco e Indio, donde la comunidad hispana lo reconoce por su calidez y su guía espiritual. Además de su labor en las parroquias, ayudó a fundar en 2011 el capítulo en español del movimiento católico Magnificat con la aprobación del obispo de la región.

programme.title: Siervo de todos
programme.desc: En un tiempo en el que la voz del Señor parece ahogada por «otras voces» y la propuesta de seguirlo entregando la propia vida puede parecer un absurdo, Dios sigue llamando a quien quiere, otorgando a través del Sacramento del Orden, la misión de servir en nombre y representación de Cristo-Cabeza en medio de la comunidad. A toda la Iglesia le urge responder a esta llamada.

programme.title: Mientras el mundo gira
programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica
programme.sub-title: Ante la superstición: ¡Sólo Jesús tiene poder!
programme.desc: El Padre Pedro nos explica que la superstición nos lleva a poner nuestra confianza en cosas o personas que, en sí, no tienen poder alguno. La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. Además responde a las preguntas llegadas al programa vía telefónica, el correo electrónico (padrepedro@ewtn.com) y Facebook (www.facebook.com/ppedronunez).

programme.desc: Los modales son buenas costumbres y cortesía, son las acciones, posturas y comportamientos externos con los que una persona demuestra respeto, educación y refinamiento hacia los demás. El saludar al llegar, dar las gracias, pedir permiso o escuchar sin interrumpir, son ejemplos básicos. El Padre Willie nos advierte que la falta de ellos causa desaprobación social. Los modales son como una caricia, no han pasado de moda, solo que están escasos.

programme.title: Conozca primero su fe católica

La superstición es, por lo tanto, una desviación de la fe en el Único que tiene poder para darnos vida nueva y vida abundante, y ese es Jesucristo. programme.title: Eden's Choice (2026)
programme.desc: In a time when the abortion debate continues to divide culture, politics, and communities across America, this deeply emotional film cuts through the noise to tell a raw and unforgettable human story, one that challenges audiences to see the person behind the issue. programme.title: Property Brothers

programme.title: Styled
programme.desc: Single mom Sony and her teen daughters envision a home that’s for the girls – feminine, beautiful, bright and modern. Without a clue of how to make it happen, they’re trusting Nicole and Caffery to get it Styled!

programme.desc: Chrissy’s multi-purpose home needs help to be as vibrant as Chrissy and her podcast with Marie, while Raymond has a house to sell that needs staging in a hurry.

programme.desc: Mohit and Kiru need Nicole and Caffery to bring a ‘styled’ look to their very empty new home, and Andrea’s trusting her first listing to these staging masters.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Since having two kids, Sonia and Peter have resorted to staycations at home, but their backyard is a headache. Brian and Sarah create a luxury vacation destination that includes a pool, spa, outdoor kitchen and a stunning four-season structure.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Becki, Shawn and their 3 kids just moved from the city to a smaller country home. To extend their living space, Brian and Sarah build a new deck, a fire pit area, and a 3-season living space, in their first ever barn rehab.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Miriam and Mark are busy parents to four kids under 10 years old. To help these hardworking parents unwind, Brian and Sarah build them a parents-only hideaway in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Soon to be married Renee and Tasos are embarrassed about their neglected backyard. Brian and Sarah make their yard honeymoon ready, with a sun deck, outdoor dining area and a Grecian inspired, 3-season garage conversion.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Dave and Jorge love art and entertaining, but with tenants in their basement and no creative space inside, Brian and Sarah turn their backyard into a creative party lounge and build a shipping container-inspired structure for an industrial feel.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Sonia & Paul are big social connectors in their community with a constant flow of visitors. Brian and Sarah turn their barren backyard into a social hotspot, complete with sunroom, giant chessboard, waterfall and stylish outdoor entertainment spaces.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Breanna & Nick’s life revolves around socializing and physical activity. Brian and Sarah convert an old, underused shed into a beautiful, zen’d out yoga studio and create backyard partying, lounging and dining areas.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Lynna is a single mom with three teenage kids and the time has come for her to have the back garden of her dreams. Brian and Sarah deliver in spades, with a 3 season hang-out, lush new landscaping, and a beautiful greenhouse.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: H and her tenant Emma are bursting out of their 3-unit home. To help out both landlord and tenants, Brian and Sarah add storage space, plus a common lounge space in the backyard, with some urban inspired design touches.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Jon, Trish, and their two children live in a quintessential family-friendly neighborhood. To give the whole community an outdoor space to enjoy, Brian and Sarah build an outdoor movie theatre in their backyard.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Janet’s love for her nine grandkids is endless. But so is the chaos they bring inside her home when they come visit. To take that energy outside, Brian and Sarah build a fun kid-zone in the backyard, but also a sophisticated adult area for Janet.

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Ex-city slickers, Lauren and Mark, miss their friends and family from the city. Brian and Sarah create a country retreat with an outdoor pad, indoor dining lounge, and a chicken coop. When Lauren and Mark’s friends visit, they'll never want to leave.

programme.title: Backyard Builds

programme.title: Backyard Builds
programme.desc: Ali and Hana have two very talented young children – and a very noisy and crowded house. To give everyone in this family their own space, Brian and Sarah turn an old garage into a kids’ music and arts hangout.

programme.title: Backyard Builds

programme.title: American Trends & Lifestyle Episode 14
programme.desc: This week on American Trends & Lifestyle, our new host Lauren Makk gets into the Halloween spirit with a look at Orlando’s seasonal fun and steps into the magical world of Willy Wonka. Plus, Trans-Siberian Orchestra celebrates 30 years of rocking the holidays, author Nathan Moris shares tips for meaningful life changes, and we go behind the scenes of the adventure thriller Heart of the Beast. We’ll also share important information to help those living with asthma better understand and manage their condition.

programme.title: Coffee with America Episode 639
programme.desc: This week on an all-new episode of Coffee with America, host Sasha Rionda celebrates fall with a coastal California getaway and smart strategies for navigating the season’s biggest sales. Plus, we share tips for protecting loved ones from online scams, managing fall allergens at home, and helping teen drivers stay safer behind the wheel. We’ll also travel to Costa Rica for a luxurious escape inspired by coffee traditions and head to Hong Kong for a colorful look at its Mid-Autumn Festival celebrations.

programme.title: 2024 YETI National Championships: Men's & Women's Boulder Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2024 YETI National Championships will be held at the USA Climbing National Training Center in Salt Lake City, UT. Join us to cheer for Team USA and the world’s best competition climbers as IFSC World Cups return to Salt Lake City. The Boulder and Speed World Cup returns May 3-5, while the Paraclimbing World Cup returns May 7-8.

programme.title: How to Paint Bolts
programme.desc: Bolt painting lesson with Evan Wisheropp, a route developer, professional climber, and photographer. On the route 'Shark Bait', a 5.12c in California, Evan demonstrates how he camouflages bolts and their surrounding, often garish paint with the help of rock-matching paint and chalk, giving lots of tips and takeaways. Then he climbs the route he has freshly painted!

programme.title: Episode 13, Weekend Whipper - The Triple Ripper
programme.desc: Michael Scarborough is nearly at the top of “Gettin’ Schooled,” a 5.12c finger crack by Evan Wisheropp in Long Canyon, when he falls, ripping out three microcams from the sandstone. A yellow Black Diamond nut catches his fall in this week’s Weekend Whipper.

programme.title: Sending a 5.14c Just Over 4 Months After Giving Birth
programme.desc: Jenya Kazbekova, Ukrainian Pro Climber & Former Olympian, discusses her send on Necessary Evil, a 5.14c/8c+ sport route in Arizona’s Virgin River Gorge. Jenya’s daughter Taisiia was born in August 2025, and she climbed throughout the pregnancy, and got right back to the sport afterwards as well. Jenya took just five sessions to redpoint Necessary Evil before sending it, her second 8c+ route. Her first, The Güllich, is in Russian annexed Crimea. Jenya is looking forward to representing Ukraine at the Olympics in 2028 and hopes to be able to go back to her country soon.

programme.title: How Mary Eden Became the Crack Queen
programme.desc: Mary Eden, Pro Climber & Instructor, discusses her past climbing wins as she gears up to climb Century Crack, the world's hardest natural roof crack. She sent Necronomicon (5.14a) in 2022 and Black Mamba (5.14b) in 2023. Eden describes the way she approaches climbing, and her outlook on the sport as a positive and uplifting community.

programme.title: Taking a Peak
programme.desc: Pro climbers Alex Honnold and Cedar Wright battle wind and a surprise snowstorm in Great Basin National Park. When the weather clears, Alex explores Ely's growing biking scene and stargazes beneath some of the darkest skies in America.

programme.desc: Lead Semi-Finals from Gaithersburg, MD. The USA Climbing National Team Trials for 2024 will take place at Sportrock Climbing Centers in Gaithersburg, MD from March 5th to March 8th. This prestigious event will showcase the top climbers in the country as they compete in three disciplines: Boulder, Lead, and Speed. The two highest-ranked U.S. athletes will earn a coveted spot on the U.S. National Team for 2024, allowing them to compete on the IFSC World Cup circuit. Some may even have the chance to compete in the Olympic Qualifying Series, where they will vie for additional spots on Team USA.

programme.title: Beneath The Ice
programme.desc: A story of curiosity, exploration and climate research inside the Greenland ice cap. Canadian adventurer, Will Gadd, uses his ice climbing skills to lead a scientific expedition into a previously unexplored territory beneath the ice sheet.

programme.title: Essential Self-Rescue for Climbers: Rappelling and Passing Knots CLIMB 18 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Learn basic self-rescue skills, and how to think critically in a climbing emergency. In this episode, guide and search-and-rescue pro Karsten Delap teaches you how to rappel in different situations as well as pass the knot in an emergency.

programme.title: Speaking out Against Bullying
programme.desc: Sasha DiGiulian's Tuesday plans are turned upside down when she has to return from a climbing trip to Nice in order to see her grandmother before she passes. During an already trying week, Sasha is tested by cyber bullying and makes the courageous choice to address the issue head on.

programme.title: 2024 Paraclimbing Finals: Session One | USA Climbing
programme.desc: Paraclimbing Finals: Session One from Gaithersburg, MD. USA Climbing will hold the 2024 Paraclimbing Nationals Championships on March 9-10 at Sportrock Climbing Center Rio in Gaithersburg, MD. Paraclimbing National Championships will be a two-round competition hosting a modified redpoint qualification round on day one and an onsight final round on day two. The climbing will be executed on top rope.

programme.title: Intro to Trad: Safe Descents CLIMB 14 | Outside Learn
programme.desc: Ease your way into trad climbing, and safely open up a ton of new terrain for you and your partner. In this episode, IFMGA guides Rob Coppolillo and Marc Chauvin take you through rappelling, lowering, and how to handle special situations.

programme.title: International Paralympic Committee Selects 2028 Medal Events
programme.desc: Reporting on the recent International Paralympic Committee's announcement of its choice medal events in the upcoming 2028 inaugural Paralympic climbing competitions. Some selections/omissions were surprising to Paralympic hopefuls. Voiceover from Climbing contributor Suzie Hodges Irby, footage from IFSC paraclimbing competitions, and remote interviews with athletes Emeline Lakrout, Mo Beck, and Ben Mayforth.

programme.title: Episode 7 | Weekend Whipper | Singularity
programme.desc: In a UGC clip, climber Mou Ding is on "Singularity" (5.12b) when his second-to-last draw pops out of his rope. Jeff Jaramillo, Head of Gear Education and Outreach at Weigh My Rack, reacts to the clip and offers his takeaways over a remote video interview, pointing out the open gate in the carabiner, as seen in the footage.

programme.title: 2025 National Team Trials: Lead Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The 2025 National Team Trials: Lead Semi-Finals. The 2025 National Team Trials Presented by YETI kick off in Mesa Rim in Austin, TX! 117 registered athletes will compete for spots on the Boulder, Lead, and Speed National Teams, with the opportunity to represent the USA at international World Cups.

programme.desc: The 2025 National Team Trials: Boulder Finals. programme.title: First Female Ascent and Exploration in Cuba
programme.desc: Sasha and friends are in Cuba for some jungle sport climbing!

programme.title: Beckett Hsin Sends V17 at 16 Years Old
programme.desc: Last week, on February 24, 16-year-old Beckett Hsin became the youngest person in the world to send the hardest confirmed grade in bouldering when he topped out on No One Mourns the Wicked (V17) in Thunder Ridge, Colorado. Here, he discusses his "boulder his age" challenge that he started when he was just 12 years old.

programme.title: Are You a Dancer or a Fighter?
programme.desc: Climbing Coach Casey Elliot explains that there are two types of climbers: the try-hard, onsighting Fighters and the meticulous, projecting Dancers. Casey explains how he and his "Dancer" climbing friend came up with this revelation and gives the advice that pushing yourself to channel both styles of climbing will help you become a more balanced climber.

programme.title: Climbing Holds... Made Out of Mushrooms
programme.desc: Climbing Editor-in-Chief Maya Silver recounts speaking with Marta Agueda and Manuela Garcia, the founders of MAD, about their sustainable climbing holds made out of the roots of mushrooms in Berlin. As approximately 7 million plastic climbing holds end up in the landfill every year, these European game changers are forging a more sustainable path for the future of gyms. Read the full story here: https://www.climbing.com/culture-climbing/sustainable-climbing-holds-mushrooms-bioresins-recycled-plastic/

programme.title: Climbing's Newest Hotbed | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha travels to Manikia, a small village in Greece, to experience an emerging climbing destination. Manikia has only recently come into the spotlight as a potential world-class climbing destination. Sasha is joined on this adventure by fellow climbers from the Petzl team. The ultimate goal is to help establish a new climbing area the right way. During this trip, Sasha and the team set new routes in calibration with local climbers and guides while discussing ecotourism's positive and negative effects on local communities.

programme.title: How to Make a Solid Tape Glove
programme.desc: Professional climber and Climbing Contributor Genevive Walker demonstrates how to make a quality tape glove to use while crack climbing. She includes pro tips like the fact that tape gloves can be reused, if the tape is removed carefully!

programme.title: How to Climb in the Steeps
programme.desc: Climbing Contributor and professional climber Genevive Walker gives tips and tricks for climbing in the steeps, demonstrating proper foot placement, core engagement, and more.

programme.title: Episode 6 | Weekend Whipper | Ripping Cams in a Swedish Finger Crack
programme.desc: Climber Fay Manners takes a fall on "Trampoline"(5.11b) in Bohuslän, Sweden, in this week's Weekend Whipper, ripping out a cam in a finger crack.

programme.title: A Guide to Climber Skincare
programme.desc: Professional climber and Climbing contributor Genevive Walker does a show-and-tell with her favorite skincare products that are useful for climbers. She covers antihydral, Rhino Dry spray, Rhino Split+ (a hyaluronic acid cream), Rhino Spit (an aloe-based spray), Rhino Repair, and the importance of tape and of filing down calluses.

programme.title: How I Deal with the Fear of Falling in the Gym
programme.desc: Avianna Frady, Instagram-popular climber @climbwithavi, shares how she deals with the fear of falling in the gym. Falling can be intimidating, especially during dynos, but she makes herself practice falling so that she gets comfortable with it and can try big moves.

programme.title: The Blind Ascensionist
programme.desc: At 14, Justin Salas lost his vision but not his inner drive for adventure. This thrill seeker will take us on a journey of learning to navigate our world legally blind while pushing past any barrier or boulder in his way en route to becoming a World Champion Climber who continues to pursue a new challenge at every turn. Through Justin’s narration, viewers will be drawn into his mindset as he navigates through his physical, mental, and emotional barriers, only to find the strength to push past any “boulders” put in front of him. When Justin lost sight, climbing helped him build resilience and relationships as he found his place in the world as a blind young adult, and now he shows the world how he sees it.

programme.title: Climbing Switzerland’s Luzzone Dam
programme.desc: Two women climb the tallest artificial climbing route in the world, the Luzzone Dam. Standing at 541 feet tall, the dam is great for those experienced in multi-pitch routes, or can be top-roped by booking a guide. The climb is described as exposed and ridiculously fun with great views. Get the full guide to climbing the dam here: https://www.climbing.com/travel/climbing-luzzone-dam/

programme.title: Grim Ripper: The Scariest Gear Fails
programme.desc: In this Halloween-themed episode of Weekend Whipper, a bunch of climbers scream as they take giant falls, the result of various gear failures.

programme.title: YETI Climbing National Championships 2026 - Boulder Semi-Finals | USA Climbing
programme.desc: The USA Climbing 2026 National Championships for Youth (YETI Nationals) at High Point Climbing and Fitness in Orlando, FL, bringing together top young climbers for Boulder, Lead, and Speed events to crown national champions and select athletes for national teams, showcasing Florida's competitive climbing scene.

programme.title: The Future of Fashion | No Days Off
programme.desc: Sasha meets up with professional Kiteboarder and swimwear designer Sensi Graves to hear what makes Sensi's business specializing in fashion. Sensi Graves is a self-made entrepreneur who started her sustainable swimwear brand - her materials are made from 100% recycled ocean plastics and reclaimed fishing nets. To round out this Oregon adventure and get the whole Hood River experience, Sasha and Sensi decide to trade sports for a day - Sasha tries kiteboarding for the first time, and Sensi tries her hand at climbing.

programme.title: Crankworx Specialized Canadian Open Downhill
programme.desc: Straight down, no mercy, watched by downhill fans around the world. The Canadian Open DH is a one-run showdown on Whistler's rooty, technical single-track — a course that separates the fast from the fearless. Elite riders from across the globe line up alongside hungry up-and-comers and amateurs, all chasing the same clock. Tune in and watch some of the world's fastest riders on the planet send it straight to the bottom.

programme.title: Crankworx Rhapsody Slopestyle
programme.desc: Staged in the “Boneyard,” the dirt stadium at the base of the Whistler Mountain Bike Park, Rhapsody Slopestyle offers the best Slopestyle mountain bikers on the planet two runs – that’s two chances for glory, two opportunities to throw down high-scoring tricks and move up the leader board, and two moments in time to leave their mark on the history of the sport. The 18 best riders in the world bring their A-game to this invitational showcase, interpreting a custom-built course and giving it their all.

programme.title: Crankworx Mont-Sainte-Anne Downhill
programme.desc: Watch the world's top riders compete on this legendary downhill track in the inaugural Crankworx Mont-Sainte-Anne festival. This world-famous race is the final stop of the 2026 Crankworx Downhill series and will test riders in the ultimate battle of speed, technique, and courage. The track features a steep, long and demanding descent, dotted with rocks, roots and impressive jumps, all in front of a roaring crowd of MTB fans.

programme.title: Crankworx Mont-Sainte-Anne Slopestyle
programme.desc: After 8 months of competition around the globe, the inaugural Slopestyle Super League (SSL) Finals have arrived. The Top 10 Men and Top 5 Women from the Season and Playoffs are going head to head for a chance to be crowned the first-ever SSL World Champion. A flagship discipline of the Crankworx World Tour, this is the first time a Slopestyle competition will be held in not only Mont-Sainte-Anne but also in Quebec at the elite level. Larger-than-life jumps and spectacular tricks, all performed with a heavy dose of steeze.

programme.title: The Year Red Bull Hardline Was Cancelled: What Really Happened?
programme.desc: Being a World Cup racer isn't just about racing the best of the best at the international series. Riders also cut their teeth on regional races, as well as fighting for bragging rights at their National Championships, and that's not all. For the last decade the best of the best have been invited to compete at the hardest race track in the world - Red Bull Hardline. Pinkbike Racing's Thibault Laly is one of those riders. What happens at the event that pushes downhill further than any other? And how do riders reconcile their desire to succeed with huge risks of potentially catastrophic injury?

programme.title: Leogang: From Bike Park To Racer's Favourite | Racing Rewind
programme.desc: Once dismissed as too much of a bike park, the track at Leogang has evolved over the past 10 years to become a favourite on the race calendar. Henry explains how this transformation happened over the past decade. Presented by: Bell Helmets

programme.title: Ticking Off This Year's SCARIEST Lines | 2024 Red Bull Rampage Practice
programme.desc: Brett Tippie takes a deep dive into the insane lines of this years Red Bull Rampage men's field.

programme.title: How To Make or Break Your Backcountry MTB Adventure
programme.desc: Welcome back to the Pinkbike Weekly Show. Christina Chappetta and Matt Beer have spent the last few weekends exploring alpine and backcountry trails around British Columbia and they’re going to share some tips from their experiences. Between the good, the bad and the ugly, hopefully they’ll inspire you to get out there and be as prepared as you can be for the unknown. Matt then takes us through his backcountry bike and how he sets it up for successful, big missions. We close out the show this week with the latest Trailforks Trail of the Week from Michigan. What would you add to your backcountry mountain bike kit?

programme.title: Maintaining Speed And Pumping Through Cornering - How To Bike Season 3 Episode 1
FMBA Gold Slopestyle | Christchurch Adventure Park, New Zealand
programme.desc: The Crankworx World Tour is a premier multi-stop series of mountain bike festivals, uniting top-tier athletes from around the globe to compete in elite-level competitions across a variety of disciplines. In 2025, Crankworx proudly celebrates 20 years of the ultimate experience in mountain biking! Crankworx Summer Series offers a platform for local and international riders to race within the Crankworx framework in emerging mountain bike destinations. Returning stronger than ever after the 2024 cancellation due to the Port Hills fire, the festival welcomes a star-studded lineup of athletes to Christchurch Adventure Park. Fans can watch their local heroes and international heavy hitters compete in the FMB Gold Cup Slopestyle, the Redemption Downhill, and Christchurch Pump Track. All events are available live on Outside TV and Pinkbike.

programme.title: Managing A DH World Cup Team Is HARD

programme.title: Canyon Spectral Review | 2022 Pinkbike Value Field Test
programme.desc: Built like a scaled-down enduro bike, the Spectral 125 AL 6 is a no-nonsense affair. Does its aggressive geometry perform on the trail, or does its travel limit it?

programme.title: Bike Delivery
programme.desc: After an exhaustive search, Ryan and Alexey select three new novice cyclists, Johanna, David, and Rachel, to start training for the Leadville Trail 100 Mountain bike race. The first step is to get their new bikes and set up their training systems.

programme.title: What Makes A Great World Cup Venue? | Racing Rewind
programme.desc: With the UCI DH World Cup visiting a new Polish venue of Bielsko-Biala this coming weekend, Henry takes a look back at some of the newer race venues of the past few years.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Flow State (2012)
programme.desc: Warren Miller’s Flow State guides viewers to the top of the world’s most striking peaks, taking you on an exhilarating journey across the globe to Norway, Austria, California, Switzerland and beyond. The powder in Japan will send you scrambling to tune-up your gear, the gravity in Telluride will have you scheduling an avalanche refresher course, and the steeps in Alaska will drive you to push a little harder during your next preseason workout. Winter is right around the corner, and it is time to enter the Flow State...where the mountain meets the mind.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Freeriders (1998)
programme.desc: “Freeriders,” embarks on its national tour from October through December and spans the globe in search of freedom. “Freeriders” captures the essence of freedom as world-class skiers and snowboarders hit the slopes in spectacular style. Warren Miller, the seventy-three year old master of cutting-edge sports films, compares “Freeriders” with “the freedom of first tracks — where your most basic instinct, your instinctive search for freedom, is finally being satisfied.” To complement all of the hard-hitting action, “Freeriders” blends extraordinary cinematography with the trademark wit of Warren Miller. Along with the refreshing voices of the film’s athletes, “Freeriders” continues to feature Warren Miller’s traditional and poignant narration that have made him a legend in the world of entertainment.

programme.title: Bottomless
programme.desc: Jonny Moseley searches for the deepest powder and the freshest snow in the world.

programme.title: Revved Up
programme.desc: Jonny travels by snowmobile to some of the craziest places and events on the planet.

programme.title: The Visionaries
programme.desc: We explore the vast region of the Columbia Mountains and focus on one of the largest ski areas in the world operated by heli ski company Canadian Mountain Holiday. Mountain guide and visionary Hans Mosier was one of the first to pioneer these runs.

programme.title: Mountain Division
programme.desc: The impact of the 10th Mountain Division (little know fathers of the modern ski industry in North America) is revealed as we dive into many of the resorts that they help create and influence after WWII.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Future Retro (2020)
programme.desc: If there is one thing you can always count on, even in a year like 2020, it is Warren Miller's annual ski film. And this year is no different. Warren Miller’s Future Retro will revel in 71 years of movie magic—with fresh stories and perspectives from across the globe, heroes from the glory days, and that retro energy keeping the winter dream alive. Travel to Switzerland with big-mountain skiers Lexi duPont and Amie Engerbreston. Explore Iceland with Aspen locals Victor Major and Baker Boyd. Go to Antarctica to closely examine the impact of climate change while seeking adventure with Protect Our Winters and athletes Elana Hight, Danny Davis and Nick Russell. And celebrate the legacy of ski pioneers like the Egan brothers, while ushering in young guns like Parkin Costain and Jack and Maria Lovely. You can’t look toward the future without taking a look back at the past. Future Retro will be that connection—past, present and future. Join the collective experience, which includes resort and retail offers from local and national partners, this fall as the legacy continues.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Here, There & Everywhere (2016)
programme.desc: It’s been 67 years since ski-film pioneer Warren Miller first picked up a camera to capture the wonder, adventure, humor, and beauty that is skiing. Since that time, Warren Miller film crews have traveled the globe—from storied slopes to hidden, snow-covered corners—to celebrate all things snowsports. Their quest has taken powder-hungry filmgoers, Here, There & Everywhere—and this year continues that legacy. This fall, witness a freeform, freeski adventure in Warren Miller Entertainment’s 67th snowsports film, Here, There & Everywhere. See JT Holmes, Jeremy Jones, Grete Eliassen, Collin Collins, Ingrid Backstrom, Tyler Ceccanti, Wendy Fisher and more as they sweep across the expanses of Alaska, Montana’s Glacier Country, Deer Valley, Greenland, Switzerland and more in the pursuit of the perfect turns. This year, don’t miss Warren Miller himself spin tales of the past as only Warren can do, reminding us that through the years, these films have truly taken audiences Here, There & Everywhere.

programme.title: Gentle Landscapes: Part 1
programme.desc: Gentle Landscapes: Part 1

programme.title: Warren Miller's Higher Ground (2005)
programme.desc: Warren Miller’s HIGHER GROUND, an independent movie slated to visit theatres across the U.S. from October through December 2005, chronicles skiers and snowboarders in their never-ending search for new and thrilling ways to ride the snow. Crisscrossing the globe, hitting the steeps of Alaska, terrain parks in Colorado, deep powder in British Columbia and cliffs in Switzerland, Warren Miller’s HIGHER GROUND brings skiing and snowboarding to life on the big screen as no other action sports film has done before as the country’s first-ever high-definition film tour. Part action/adventure, part documentary, Warren Miller’s HIGHER GROUND also features legendary athletes such as big mountain skiers Jeremy Nobis and Seth Morrison, Ski-BASE jumping innovator Shane McConkey, and the sport’s hot-dogging icon, Glen Plake, as well as up and coming stars like five-year-old phenom Bridger Gile.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Impact (2004)
programme.desc: Celebrate the onset of winter and the thrill of action sports with IMPACT, the 55th annual Warren Miller movie, as it tours the country making stops in 250 cities from October through December, 2004. IMPACT showcases winter sports’ top athletes and local heroes on the big screen as they travel to fabled and exotic locations around the globe in search of the perfect ride, deepest powder and sickest lines. Each screening of the movie is a high-energy live event booked as a limited engagement, often for one night only.

programme.title: Going for Gold
programme.desc: The US Ski and Snowboard teams have done well in recent years. Much of the success is a result of superstars like Bode Miller, Shawn White, and Lindsey Vonn. In this episode of Season Pass we look to the next generation of US hopefuls.

programme.title: High Risk High Reward
programme.desc: When youre pushing the limits of skiing and riding, it can be risky business but these athletes know that a few close calls are part of the game when youre after the ultimate reward.

programme.title: Road Tripping
programme.desc: From Montana to Alaska and across the pond to Norway, athletes track down perfect conditions by any mode of transportation necessary to be in the right place at the right time.

programme.title: Extending the Season
programme.desc: Skiers search for an endless winter by heading south to Portillo, Chile, way north to Svalbard, Norway and up to the glaciers of Alaska.

programme.title: Warren Miller's In Search Of Skiing (1977)
programme.desc: We’re all searching for something but the real question is what. For people like Scott Miller, John Clendenin, Dave Clark, Bob Burns, Bab Salerno, and countless others well they’re all In Search of Skiing. Warren Miller takes you back to some of the most original and earliest forms of skiing and extreme skiing. Take a ski trip from Switzerland to Morocco, over to Spain, and across the pond to Maine and Canada and find out for yourself if you’re one of the many people out there In Search of Skiing.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Journey (2003)
programme.desc: From the legendary filmmaking company comes an all-new film packed with incredible action cinematography from around the globe. Loyal Warren Miller fans will be lured by this film’s new heights in powder, cliffs and exotic locations, a formula that induces seven out of ten audience members to return annually. JOURNEY delivers the very best of this year’s skiing and riding, fusing terrain park progression with the backcountry, and technical lines with endless powder shots. Warren Miller camera crews chase the snow year round. JOURNEY takes viewers along for the ride in the quest for perfect conditions from Aspen to Chile and Alaska to Morocco. Journey across four continents with 19 film crews and 73 athletes--including icons Glen Plake, Bode Miller, and Terje Haakonsen--for the adventure of a lifetime. JOURNEY also includes a tribute to an athlete who pioneered the sport of snowboarding - Craig Kelly. Whether riding rails in Breckenridge or skiing with best friends in Chamonix, this year's film shows that it's not about the destination; it's about the journey.

programme.title: Warren Miller's Like There's No Tomorrow (2011)
programme.desc: Watch world-class athletes – including Chris Davenport, Julia Mancuso, Daron Rahlves, Colby West and Seth Wescott – drop lines most of us only see in our dreams and learn, frame-by-frame, how to live . . . Like There’s No Tomorrow. Check warrenmiller.com for a complete showcase of this year’s film locations and extended athlete bios. . . . Like There's No Tomorrow is your annual reminder that winter is on its way and, with it, an adrenaline-fueled dance with gravity. “We welcome winter with everything we've got,” explains the film’s director and producer, Max Bervy. “Because, while there’s always a tomorrow, there are only so many dawns with fresh snow.”

programme.desc: A millionaire offers ten thousand dollars to five people if they agree to stay overnight in a large, spooky, rented house. This super shocker of the century was a smash hit upon its 1959 release. For architecture buffs, the home used for the exteriors of the haunted house was actually designed by Frank Lloyd Wright and built in 1924!

programme.title: Night of the Living Dead (In Color & Restored) (Edited Version)

This over-the-top disk includes a restored original black and white version, and a color version that will thrill the horror film fan and horrify the film purist. programme.title: Raiders of Old California
programme.desc: The end of the Mexican-American War finds a brazen U.S. Calvary captain and his men taking over a Spanish land grant. Albert C. Gannaway (The Badge of Marshall Brennan) directs an all-star cast including Jim Davis (Jock Ewing of Dallas), Arleen Whelan (Young Mr. Lincoln) and Lee Van Cleef (The Good, The Bad, and the Ugly). Also, look for appearances by legendary country & western stars Marty Robbins and Faron Young.

programme.title: The Fighting Westerner
programme.desc: A mining engineer tries to solve the murders of several heirs to a valuable radium mine in this western drama from Paramount Pictures. Stars include Charles Chic Sale, and in one of his early roles, Randolph Scott. This feature, also known as Rocky Mountain Mystery, was directed by Oscar winner Charles Barton, who would go on to direct several popular television shows, including Petticoat Junction and Family Affair...

programme.title: Death Valley
programme.desc: A love story and a search for gold in the Valley of Death! Dubbed simple, powerful and dramatic by the New York Times on the date of its release, Death Valley is indeed an elegant depiction of love and deception in the American desert during the Gold Rush. In what was to be the final film of famed silent film director Paul Powell (Polyanna), a cast of mostly unknown actors produces uniformly excellent work. Lyrical and graceful, Powells film spins the tale of a young boy who finds love and gold, only to have it stolen from him.

programme.title: Riders of the Whistling Pines
programme.desc: GENE AUTRY COMES ROARING OUT OF THE SKIES...to save the forests from an outlaw lumber ring! When ex forest ranger Gene tries to interfere with a gang destroying the timberland, hes framed for cattle-poisoning and set up for a murder charge. Yet, he still has time to sing some great cowboy songs, including Its My Lazy Day, and Hair of Gold. This is Gene Autry in a slightly different role, with some great footage filmed at Big Bear Valley and San Bernardino National Forest.

programme.title: Colorado Kid
programme.desc: Cowboy star Bob Steele (Valley of Hunted Men, The Trail Blazers) headlines this Poverty Row western drama. As the Colorado Kid, he's falsely arrested for murder and has to clear himself. The colorful cast includes Ernie Adams, Frank LaRue, and Horace Murphy, with direction by Sam Newfield (The Terror of Tiny Town, The Mad Monster).

programme.title: The Two Gun Man
programme.desc: Ken Maynard stars in this vintage western about ranchers under threat from hired gunmen. Director Phil Rosen, whose career dated back to working with Thomas Edison and included several Charlie Chan features, keeps the action hot with help from a strong ensemble, including Charles King, Murdock MacQuarrie, and a horse named Tarzan! Maynard plays Blackie Weed, a marshall going undercover to capture and arrest some cattle rustlers.He finds himself up against some very bad men, and he's soon framed for murder. Watch as Blackie blazes his way to vindication with a .45 in either hand and the flame of righteous anger in his eyes... Kitty: Nita Martin. Joe Kearney: Lafe McKee. Lem Tolliver: Tom London. Ranch Foreman: Walter Perry

programme.title: Young Bill Hickock
programme.desc: Roy Rogers stars as the title character in this actionpacked feature from Republic Pictures. programme.desc: Terry and Larry go on a swashbuckling adventure when they test two scenes from the 1920’s film, The Black Pirate starring Douglas Fairbanks, Senior. Terry will see if he can knock down a ships mast with a canon, and then test gravity as he slides down a sail with only a knife.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Terry Loves 70's Cop Shows"

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Breaking Terry Badly"
programme.desc: Terry falls victim to Walter White in Breaking Bad, and Terry and Larry test 3 separate scenes from this iconic series, 2 of which need the help of Special Effects expert Andre Ellingson, including lighting a gas tank on fire and chemically burning through a steal door.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S3 - "Getting to Know Rick O'Shea"
programme.desc: In this episode we get know Larry’s friend Rick O’Shea (Ricochet). Terry and Larry test several different films where bullets are manipulated in order to get an amazing result. They test scenes from Skyfall, Suicide Squad, American Ultra, and The Bear.

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "Paris & Barcelona"

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "London"

programme.title: Around the World in 80 Tricks S1 - "South Korea - Night"

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon visits The Granary in rural Hampshire, an upmarket restaurant which, at 200 seats, is the biggest he's ever taken on. It promises classy modern British cuisine but, in reality, the fussy menu features food sourced from all over the world and the locals, disconcerted by its exclusive reputation, are staying far away. Head Chef Martin doubles as parole officer to his unruly teenage charges in the kitchen, while Nigel stubbornly struggles to contain the front-of-house chaos that he's created

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Gordon visits is The Fish and Anchor, pub restaurant near Lampeter in rural West Wales, owned and run by ex-boxer Mike and his wife Caron. Mike, a self-taught cook, is a one-man pressure cooker in the kitchen as he struggles to accommodate a vast menu, while Caron's unique style of front-of-house management includes abusing the customers, and her husband, in equal measure. Every night they go twelve rounds with the local clientele who are fast deserting them to the tune of a 1,000 per week loss.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue is The Runaway Girl, a tapas bar-cum-nightclub in Sheffield city centre on the brink of collapse. The owner Justin Rowntree wont listen to reason, and his head chef and best friend Ritchie has had enough. Gordon is on hand to help the friends weather the storm with a credit crunch menu solution designed to take on the chains, but can Gordon save Justins failing business, and prevent his friendship with Ritchie ending up in tatters?

programme.title: The Cops
programme.desc: Its Halloween weekend and the Bodycam Squad are on the lookout for things that go bump in the night. Its not long before theyre called to investigate a skirmish at a nightclub, where a bouncer has had her hair pulled out by a female clubber in Stoke! Meanwhile the hunt is on for two suspected robbers whove given the police the slip on an industrial site. Theyre the main suspects in a spate of diesel fuel thefts costing local businesses 50,000. Late in the night, a van, which has been used for syphoning fuel is discovered in a remote part of Burton. When two men show up, the cops are certain theyve found the fuel thieves but they hadnt reckoned on the mens curious alibi. And, police dog Jax, leads a manhunt for some suspected van thieves. Using her powerful sense of smell, she follows their tracks to some bushes. What happens next makes it clear that a dog isnt always a mans best friend!

programme.title: The Cops
programme.desc: In the dead of night, the Bodycam Cops come across a man smashing his way into two high street stores with an axe. Inside one of the Stoke shops, astonishing CCTV footage captures the moment when the robber leads the cops on a merry dance, up and down the aisles! Another business has been targeted in the market town of Uttoxeter. This time, a hairdressers that has been hit twice with hundreds of pounds of hair products stolen. When Rich tracks down the main suspect, incredibly, he discovers the mans own house has just been burgled! And, Kerry, bravely deals with a shocking incident, where a man has been glassed in the back of the head while out for a drink in a pub. Fortunately, the suspects, a drunk woman and her boyfriend, are quickly apprehended by the pubs bouncers.

programme.title: The Cops
programme.desc: After complaints from neighbours in a residential street about anti-social behaviour related to drug activity, The Bodycam Squad prepare for a daylight raid on a house in Burton upon Trent. All kitted out with the latest body-worn video cameras and a door enforcer, they smash their way into the suspected drugs den. At the end of a long shift for undercover Bodycam Cops Graham and Greg, something extraordinary catches their attention - a man hanging by his trousers from some nine foot high railings. And, even more incredibly, hes sound asleep! Also, Alfie Bradley, a metal sculptor has created his own monument to the victims of knife crime. Using more than 100,000 weapons seized by the police or handed in during nationwide knife amnesties, hes crafted a majestic 27 foot figure called The Knife Angel.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay: Shark Bait
programme.desc: The shark is one of the most extraordinary creatures on earth terrifying, beautiful and, for many, delicious. Fascinated by both how it is caught, and how it is consumed, Gordon explores the shark fishing industry, the history and culture behind shark fin soup, as well as the increasing demand for shark meat. But with shark numbers in decline he asks whether shark is a dish that needs to come off our menus for good.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Tim Gray is 21. Hes the Head Chef at Bonapartes in Silsden, West Yorkshire and he specializes in fine dining. He has ambitions to be a TV chef and one day hopes to open restaurants in London, Paris and New York. Unfortunately, as Gordon Ramsay discovers, Tim cant even cook an omelets and when he attempts to make dinner for his parents at home he manages to set the cooker alight. A true kitchen nightmare if ever you saw one. With no customers and a fridge full of fancy ingredients, Bonapartes is losing money fast. Owner Sue Ray has run out of ideas. Shes never owned a restaurant before and has been led astray by Tims enthusiasm for vanilla fumes and balsamic reductions. Ramsay soon establishes that what the people of Silsden really want to eat is Beef and Ale Pie and Treacle Tart and when he gets the menu back to basics the restaurant is chocker block. But can Tim cope with a full dining room when he hasnt ever cooked for more than 6 people at once? And will this simplistic style of cooking satisfy his hungry ambition?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Saturday night at the Glass House Restaurant in Ambleside is a nightmare. Orders in the kitchen are mixed up, foods not cooked properly and the customers are complaining. Not only is the chef in tears, but the owners on the brink as well. Neil Farrells owned the Lake District restaurant for 3 years and hes up to this eyes in debt. The business wont survive if the restaurants only busy on a Saturday night but with only 3,000 residents in the town, Neil has to attract the influx of visitors if hes going to fill the 90 seats every night. Gordon Ramsay rolls up his sleeves and gets involved in every detail of the business from scrubbing the grimy, slimy kitchen walls to teaching the waiters how to sell the food. He decides that the head chef is the weak link and sets about getting the kitchen in order. Ramsays not one to tread lightly - the waiter is told he has bad breath, the kitchen porters given a bollocking for dropping the cutlery, and owners invited outside for his criticisms of Ramsays Caesar salad. When Ramsay takes the head chef out of the equation, he discovers a great deal of talent in the young cooks.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The Walnut Tree Inn is in trouble theres no head chef, the customers have dwindled, and the owner has had to sell the family home to keep the business afloat. The Walnut Tree Inn in South Wales became a national institution under the ownership of Franco and Ann Tauscher, who successfully ran it for 37 years. But when fellow Italian Francesco bought the place 3 years ago he made the mistake of turning the warm and welcoming country inn into a cold and stark London-style restaurant. He achieved a Michelin star for the food but soon after that he lost his head chef. Donning his chefs whites and apron, Francesco tries to run the kitchen and be the host in the restaurant. Consequently he fails in both jobs. The customers arent returning and the foods going downhill. Ramsays first job is to recruit a new head chef so the owner can woo the customers and stop meddling in the kitchen. But hes also intent on making the dining room a cosier place and scotching rumours by bringing the previous owners back to lend Francesco their support for the Walnut Trees 40th Anniversary celebrations.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: Nick and Richard are self-confessed restaurant virgins. Theyve both had successful careers in the brewery business so when they bought Moore Place last summer they thought their dream had come true. What they hadnt fathomed was just how difficult it would be to fill the 90-seater oak-paneled restaurant or find a chef who could cook decent food. Their first mistake was to paint the building purple. The wealthy Surrey residents hated it and refuse to enter the building. Weve got gold medals in fucking it up, admits Richard, and he cant think of a single evening when the restaurants run smoothly. Ramsay discovers some fundamental problems a chef who cant cook, a bunch of sultry waiters and a building that looks more like a funeral parlour than a restaurant. Can these brewery whizz-kids turn this former failing Berni Inn into a profitable business when they are continually faced with never-ending staff problems and a complete lack of know-how in the kitchen? If theyre going to succeed Ramsay has to teach them the rudiments of running a restaurant before they can even think of making a profit.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits a Caribbean style resort hotel in Fort Pierce, Florida where the young inexperienced owner, Brian is making guests time at the hotel miserable with filthy rooms, late night concerts and shocking service. Brian has lost control, leaving the hotel staff to run wild. Gordon quickly realizes hes going to need something short of a miracle if hes going to stop this place from going under water.

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Island Park, Idaho to try and rescue the failing Anglers Lodge. Despite building the stunning lodge with his own hands, owner Dave Ebey has lost his passion and it has almost cost him his business. Gordon discovers a family tragedy has devastated the Ebeys and caused them to shy away from the hotel and the community. Gordon is desperate to help this couple at their breaking point but is he too late?

programme.title: Extreme Salvage Squad
programme.desc: Team Salvage has been called in to rescue a stranded vessel stuck in a mangrove jungle in North Queensland. It got blown in there by Cyclone Debbie. The only way they can get it out is to winch it out. But theres a problem. Theyve damaged the road on their way in to the mangroves and the boat has snapped in half.

programme.title: Extreme Salvage Squad
programme.desc: Team Salvage is trying to refloat a damaged vessel. The owners want to keep it and get it repaired. The squad successfully winches it out only to discover its leaking and is full of toxic fumes. They call in a favor from a local boatyard owner who agrees to slip and store the boat the next day. Their only chance to save the yacht is to tie it up to a jetty overnight. But theres a major storm front blowing in threatening to destroy the boat and the jetty.

programme.title: Extreme Salvage Squad
programme.desc: Team Salvage is towing a damaged yacht to a North Queensland boatyard. The vessel has a broken keel, no steering capacity and its taking on water. Theres a risk it will sink at sea. The tide has turned. Tensions are high. And theyre running out of time. And now they have to repay a favor to the boatyard owner. The salvage game is all about you scratch my back and Ill scratch yours. It will be their most dangerous salvage operation yet.

programme.title: Extreme Salvage Squad
programme.desc: Team Salvage is in the middle of a major rescue. But things are not looking good. Their winch tank retriever is bogged, their salvage Ute is bogged and the excavator they brought in to help them is also bogged. And thats just the start of their troubles. Theyve been commissioned to remove a giant floating pontoon that wont float. Reputations are on the line.

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for the first programme of the new series is La Lanterna in Letchworth, Hertfordshire. Twenty- eight-year-old owner and head chef Alex offers modern Italian cuisine, a taste of Little Italy in Englands first garden city, and the restaurant is run by his best mate maitre d Gavin, helped by his ex-air hostess girlfriend Emily. But Alex has no customers, cookers that dont work and an expensive menu thats about as authentically Italian as a spag bol. He re-mortgaged his house to buy the business, its losing 1,000 a week, he hasnt slept for months but still runs round town in a flash car (number plate: A1CHEF) thats worth more than the restaurant. Running out of money, inspiration and energy, Alex is on the verge of losing everything. Gordon rolls up his sleeves and sets to work on the encrusted kitchen cookers and hapless front-of-house staff. Can a strict diet of brutal honesty, radical food surgery and undiluted energy turn things round, or is it only a matter of time before the lights go out at La Lanterna for good?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights second programme is D-Place in Chelmsford, Essex run by Mexican born Israel and his English partner Tara. Theyve sunk 150,000 of their own money into their trendy caf bar which offers a vast selection of fusion cuisine. In charge is Executive Chef Philippe, producing everything from all-day breakfasts to hoi sin noodles with an astounding lack of flair; the plastic food is dire and boomerangs back from the dining room as soon as its cooked. Restaurant manager, spunky Essex boy Dave, loathes his chef, and their mutual hatred spills over into permanent running battles. Faced with dysfunctional staff and a disastrous menu, Gordon is about to face the longest week of his professional life. Can he quell the panic, banish the deep fat fryer and bring D-Place back from the dead, or will it disappear forever?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights third programme is Momma Cherris Soul Food Shack, an intimate forty- seater a stones throw from Brightons sea front. Big soul momma, owner CHARITA JONES, produces a menu of irresistibly unique classics from the Deep South. The foods hard to fault but the punters are nowhere to be seen, Head Chef Brian and a rag-tag collection of part-timers are taking the mickey - and despite working a seven-day week Charitas got an empty restaurant and a 65,000 debt. If ever there was a case of too many cooks, this is it. Charitas a natural, but shes never made a profit on the restaurant and is now facing financial disaster. Can Gordon successfully shut her out of the kitchen, get the chef back on the boil and put the soul back into the business, or will the shack shut up shop for good?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights fourth programme is La Riviera, a fine dining restaurant in Inverness. Owned by multi-millionaire Barry Larson and costing 8000 a week to run, the place boasts top French chef Loic Lefebvre and an impeccably-trained kitchen staff with Michelin star studded backgrounds. Loic is on a mission, to bring sophisticated French cooking to the home of haggis, tatties and deep-fried Mars bars. But though hes hungry for success, hes arrogant and the foods pretentious. The locals arent biting and the restaurants empty most nights. Theres a sharp smell of dj vu in the air for Gordon whose own venture in Scotland - Amaryllis - had to close. This week its personal as Ramsay tries to save La Riviera from the same fate. Can Gordon tone down their act, demystify the menu and, most importantly, get the punters in?

programme.title: Ramsay's Kitchen Nightmares
programme.desc: The venue for tonights program is Clubway 41, despite being voted Blackpool Tourist Board Restaurant of the year, the place is dire straits. It is the prime example of HOW NOT TO RUN A RESTAURANT. Owner DAVE is the flakey self-appointed head chef, who hasnt been in a kitchen for 30 years and cant cook. His partner DAWN invents bizarre dishes for the menu, ranging from tomato and cointreau soup to pork with brie, nectarine and whiskey sauce. Gordon faces a hellish week as Clubway 41 is breaking every rule in book. Can he bring Dave, Dawn and their food back down to earth?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay visits Meson de Mesilla, a luxury Tuscan-style hotel in Las Cruces, New Mexico. Owner and child-star, Cali Szczawinski, purchased the hotel to perform Cher songs every night to a captive audience. Too busy trying to hit the high notes on stage (the hotel has three of them), Cali has failed to notice that shes falling flat when it comes to what her hotel guests need. The bedrooms are empty, the hotels restaurant is failing, and Gordon witnesses a shocking exit that no one saw coming. Can Gordon turn back time? Or is this boutique hotel, and its singing owner, beyond his help?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon Ramsay checks in to The Monticello Hotel in Longview, Washington, owned by Phillip Lovingfoss: a wealthy individual with a fleet of classic cars, an array of diamond rings and a drinking problem so serious that it is threatening to destroy his hotel, and his life. Gordon discovers the extent of Phillips problem when he sees shocking news about the owner splashed all over the front page of the newspaper. Can Gordon save fifty staff jobs and keep the doors to this ninety year old hotel (a place once described as the jewel of Longview) open, or is he too late?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Applegate, Oregon, to try to rescue the failing Applegate River Lodge. Despite being over a million dollars in debt, the Applegates owner, Richard Davis, is more interested in smoking cannabis in his Butt Hut than he is in fixing the problems of this family-built inn. Richards sons Duke and Dusty are too busy fighting each other to notice the ever-increasing debt, leaving their mother, Joanna with the entire burden of the inns finances resting on her shoulders. Can Gordon turn this family around before the hotel and the family legacy are destroyed? And how will he react to a room full of dancing mushrooms and a dog that swims through the air?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits Starkville, Mississippi to try to rescue the failing Hotel Chester. Despite having over 40 years experience in the hotel business, owner David Mollendor is at a loss on how to make his dream of owning his own hotel work. Sukie, his wife, is struggling as the hotel restaurants chef, tackling the role without any culinary experience, and sinking fast. Gordon discovers a family tragedy which explains why this couple have become trapped in their hotel and are drowning in debt. Gordon is desperate to help the two owners escape from their suffering, but is he too late to stop the hotels doors closing for good?

programme.title: Hotel Hell
programme.desc: Gordon visits West Dover in Vermont, to try to save a dog-friendly hotel thats desperately in need of help. Sandy MacDougall, the owner, runs the hotel like a hostel with unpaid staff staying in the rooms instead of paying guests. Can Gordon get the Four Seasons back on track before Sandy loses everything? Or is the kindest thing simply to put this dog-friendly hotel to sleep?

programme.title: Self-Reliance - How It Can Help You Get Farther Ahead
programme.desc: In this episode of "The Rundown with Ramon," media consultant Maha Abouelenein discusses her new book, "Seven Rules of Self-Reliance." In this interview with Ramon Ray, publisher of ZoneofGenius.com, Abouelenein shares insights from her career working with tech giants and high-profile individuals, offering practical advice for personal and professional growth. She emphasizes the importance of creating value, managing one's reputation, and adopting a long-term mindset. Abouelenein also shares personal experiences that shaped her approach to life and work, providing listeners with actionable strategies for success in today's fast-paced world.

programme.title: Black Owned Stock Exchange is Expanding Public Market Access
programme.desc: Joe Cecala, co-founder of The Dream Exchange, is on a mission to create America's first minority-owned stock exchange. In an interview with small business expert Ramon Ray, Cecala outlined his vision for revolutionizing capital formation for small and underserved businesses. The Dream Exchange aims to fill a crucial gap in the market by providing public market access to companies seeking $5-100 million in funding, a range often overlooked by traditional financial institutions. The exchange's focus on underserved markets, including minority-owned businesses and companies in overlooked regions, sets it apart from existing exchanges. Cecala emphasized the broader implications of this venture, seeing it as a catalyst for innovation, job creation, and economic growth across diverse communities. While still navigating the complex regulatory process, The Dream Exchange is poised to potentially reshape the landscape of public markets, offering new opportunities for both entrepreneurs and investors. Cecala's parting message encapsulates the exchange's ethos: "Don't quit on your dreams."

programme.title: Stanley on the Go
programme.desc: Stanley Siegel, the late broadcaster, known to millions for his groundbreaking and often controversial interviews on WABC-and with Stanley On The Go he single-handedly redefines the travel show. Indeed, he redefines the notion of adventure: you don't have to be a young Olympian to have a zest for life. Experience shouldn't - and doesn't - end at 60. Stanley shows that there's more to retirement than bingo and shuffleboard on the Lido deck. He's an inspiration. Stanley takes us headlong around the globe: whether he's on a camel in Giza, the deck of a Navy aircraft carrier off San Diego, straddling a speeding motorbike through the streets of Moscow, or balancing on top of the Sydney Harbor Bridge, each episode is a tour de force with a force of nature. Stanley is irrepressible, his commentary is not only informative and enlightening, but is also often surprising and frequently irreverent. He shows us the iconic sights-the Grand Tour-but also uncovers the unexpected.

programme.title: UFA 429 - Red Owl BoxFest XIV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Red Owl Boxfest XIV part 2 from Houston, Texas. Watch as Alex Dionis the hometown favorite makes his pro-debut against Andrew Flamm and in the main event Javier Martinez takes on Wayne Lawrence in a six round super-lightweight match.

programme.title: UFA 478 - Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 29 part 1 from the Sala Sporturilor Constantin Jude in Timisoara, Romania. Starting off in the welterweight division, Ionel Balan takes on Adrian Maxim under superfight K1 rules. In a super middleweight bout, Andei Varga and Bogdan Takacs step into the ring while Valentin Bordianu and Cristian Conea meet up for a heavyweight match. Eduard Gafencu and Florin Lambagiu take to the ring in the co-main event in the light-heavyweight division under superfight MMA rules - boxing with MMA gloves.

programme.title: UFA 459 - Real Fight Promotion 100
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Real Fight Promotion 100 from Ukraine. In this special centenial event RFP brings its viewers an exciting night of fights. First up Stanislav Bogush and Nazar Pryshliak faceoff in the flyweight division followed by Timofiy Mytkalyk versus Ruslan Danyliuk. Also Vyacheslav Vaseichuk and Andriy Dzioba square off. In the Grand Prix finals, the two remaing fighters Roman Bandrivchak and Stanislov Bogush vye for the championship.

programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes 10
programme.desc: UFA's Baddest Babes episode 10 features Giselle Moreira and Daiane Firmino from SFT Brazil, Chandra Engle and Rachel Dovidio from NAAFA. Plus you won't want to miss famous fighers Julie Malenfant taking on Sara McMann and Anna Barone facing Charmaine Tweet from Blackeye MMA.

programme.title: UFA's Baddest Babes 11
programme.desc: UFA's Baddest Babes episode 11 features SFT's Bianca Sattlemeyer who steps into the cage with Florencia Aleona Greco, Julia Polastri takes on Jessica Cunha and female fightes from Caged Fury Tecia Torres and Rebecca Gruitza take to the cage. Don't miss the featured fighters from Blackeye Barb Honchak versus Roxanne Modafferi.

programme.title: UFA 340 - United Fight League (UFL) 3 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents United Fight League (UFL) 3 part 1 from Arizona. Veronika Smolkova looks to continue her winning streak as she faces the more experienced Brittney Cloudy. Striker Nikolay Veretennikov (10-4) steps in the cage with striker opponent Luis Iniguez (6-2) and Chris Mecate faces Canaan Kawaihae in a featherweight Grand Prix semi-final bout. Also watch as Justin Wetzell and Brandon Lewis battle it out in the cage in the semi-final for the Bantamweight Championship.

programme.title: UFA 341 - United Fight League (UFL) 3 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents United Fight League 3 part 2 from Arizona. In this episode watch Lajuan Davis (5-0) take on Ryan Loder (5-1) as they compete to move on to the finals in the Middleweight Grand Prix. Valodia Aivazian and Amun Cosme battle for the win to move on for a shot at the Bantamweight Title. In the main event Shane Sobnosky faces Ty Gwerder in a fight for the Middleweight Title.

programme.title: UFA 428 - Clan Wars 51 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 1 from Belfast, Ireland. Starting off the night, Jack McCrory squares off against Peter Thompson and in two back to back female fights, Gemma Coghill faces the younger Alexa Pagaduan, while Anneka Bower takes on Lisa Murtagh. Also in this episode Conor McAlister and Kelsey Crossey face off in the catchweight division while Michael Swann and Cian Sweeney take to the cage.

programme.title: UFA 431- Clan Wars 51 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 2 from Belfast, Ireland. First up in this episode Justis Neun takes on Callum Carville in the catchweight division while Ricardo Dearaujo takes on Andy Wilders in a flyweight bout. Watch as Simon Sackey takes to the cage with Maksims Torskis in the heavyweight division. In a bantamweight contest, Ronan Deegan faces Adrian Barrow and Kelsey Crossey is matched up agains Jason McCourtney for a catchweight bout. In a match for the vacant featherweight Clan Wars title, Jede Paulo fights Nathan Chambers for the belt.

programme.title: UFA 435 - Clan Wars 51 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Clan Wars 51 part 3 from Belfast, Ireland. In the featherweight division Nikola Ivanovic faces Damien McKenna in an MMA matchup and Fynn O'Neill takes on Padraig Irvine in the Catchweight fight. Ash Williams and Ciaran Mullholand take to the cage while Kian McCarton takes on Billy Sutherland for the Flyweight title. In the main event Lethal Shea Leathem challenges Jamie the Spider Monkey McCaugherty in a Welterweight championship title fight.

programme.title: UFA 483 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 1 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. In a Welterweight bout, Fedya Chobanyan steps into the ring with Jeffrey Bishop in a Welterweight bout followed by a match in the Featherweight division when Matthew Nester takes on Joshua Brown, making his pro-debut. In the main event, the UNF Flyweight title is on the line when Trevor Wells, a protégé of Conor Mcgregor challenges Mexican lawyer Gianni Vasquez

programme.title: UFA 487 - Up Next Fighting 17 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Up Next Fighting 17 part 2 from the Burbank Airport Convention Center in Southern California. Up first in the bantamweight division, Sammy Caceres steps into the cage with Jose Hernandez. In a featherweight contest Attila Erret takes on Cole Smith while Travis Horn and Minsuh Jung face off in a middlewight bout. In the main event the flyweight title is on the line when Pargev Khachatrian takes on Nathan Hawthorne in a grappler versus strker contest.
